note: Scripture authority is the Open Word Bible (OWB), Amharic, Balanced edition (CC0), bundled as library/data/bible/owb-am-b.json.gz and read offline (owb-am). Every Scripture quotation in this sermon was re-quoted to it verbatim (founder decision, 2026-11-18: Amharic quotes OWB everywhere), replacing the 1962/2003 UBS New Testament wording and the shipped works' Old Testament wording the first translation carried.

A `mined` row is a verbatim OWB span in that block: the whole verse, the shortest contiguous span carrying the quoted clause, or exact OWB pieces joined with '…'; a verbatim recitation without quote marks counts (founder rule, 2026-11-19). `self_rendered` rows each carry a `why`: allusions in Simpson's prose, and places where he argues from an AV wording OWB does not have. Block indexes are the requote_inventory's (the first translation's notes sat one block late).

Judgement calls: the sermon's refrain 'All things are possible to him that believeth' is OWB Mark 9:23 «ለሚያምን ሰው ሁሉ ነገር ይቻላል» everywhere it recurs, including the two unmarked recitations in block 14; its twin 'All things are possible with God', which Simpson calls 'exactly parallel', is quoted from OWB Matthew 19:26 «ለእግዚአብሔር ግን ሁሉ ይቻላል» (Mark 10:27 in OWB reads «እግዚአብሔር ሁሉን ማድረግ ይችላል», which loses the parallel). In block 35 «ብትችልስ፣ እመን» and the Mark 9:23 promise are now two quotations, the first his. Revelation 22:11's two clauses are quoted in OWB's order (filthy, then holy). Habakkuk 2:4 keeps OWB's «በታማኝነቱ» (faithfulness) where Simpson reads 'by faith'. 'The faith of God' (Mark 11:22 margin, Gal 2:20) stays his: it is the point of his closing argument.
